faq.question: What is the best time to trek in Nepal?
faq.answer: The best trekking seasons are autumn (September to November) and spring (March to May). These periods offer clear skies, moderate temperatures, and excellent mountain views. However, some treks can be done year-round with proper preparation.

faq.question: Do I need previous trekking experience?
faq.answer: Not necessarily! We offer treks for all experience levels, from beginner-friendly trails to challenging high-altitude expeditions. We'll help you choose a trek that matches your fitness level and experience.

faq.question: What's included in the trek package?
faq.answer: Our packages typically include airport transfers, accommodation, meals during the trek, experienced guides and porters, trekking permits, and emergency support. Specific inclusions vary by trek, so please check individual trek details.

faq.question: How do I prepare physically for a trek?
faq.answer: We recommend cardiovascular training (hiking, running, cycling) for 2-3 months before your trek. Focus on building endurance and leg strength. We'll provide a detailed preparation guide upon booking.

faq.question: What about altitude sickness?
faq.answer: We design our itineraries with proper acclimatization days to minimize altitude sickness risk. Our guides are trained to recognize symptoms and carry necessary medications. We also have emergency evacuation procedures in place.

faq.question: Can I customize my trek itinerary?
faq.answer: Absolutely! We specialize in tailor-made itineraries. Whether you want to add extra days, change the route, or combine multiple experiences, we'll work with you to create your perfect adventure.
